comment: The toolchains of hyper that no other file declares. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs (the Python of the checks with uv, Composer, alint of make layout-check, and the Go and the wasm-bindgen of make test-go and make node-package) and mise.lock locks them for every platform of the bootstrap (HR-81). phpExtension.minors names the PHP minors of the extension polyspec_hyper, which the matrix of the job php of .github/workflows/assets.yml builds on each platform and release-platform-assets of packages/release.mk requires before it uploads (binding GN-19a).

llvm.reason: the major release of the LLVM whose libclang and clang the bindgen of ext-php-rs uses in make hyper-ext and make release-php-ext of packages/release.mk (binding GN-19d, GN-19h): clang-sys takes the libclang of the highest LLVM that it finds and bindgen asks the clang of PATH for its headers, so the two differ on a machine with several LLVM releases. No recipe installs it: the ubuntu-26.04 images hold it at /usr/lib/llvm-<major> and macOS takes the Homebrew formula llvm@<major>, the default LLVM_ROOT of the recipe
llvm.removal: when the build of the PHP extension no longer runs bindgen, or a release of ext-php-rs no longer reads the libclang of the machine
